assessments.name: Structured Oral Exam for DENT 6382
assessments.description: Structured Oral Examination 1 hour offered for reading of questions and structuring answers. 1 hour for answering of questions. Questions mostly but not limited to Fixed and Removable Prosthodontics.

assessments.name: Seminar presentation DENT 6382 Semester 1
assessments.description: Seminar preparation, submission and presentation. All literature reviews need to be submitted to the Course Director and / Supervisor AT LEAST 7 days in advance of presentation. Active participation is expected in all seminars.

assessments.name: Portfolio Submission
assessments.description:
Report on all written work including seminars and study groups and presentations as well as any auxillary work done, conference attendance and presentations. Does NOT include case reports and presentations.
Also include a chapter on Self Directed Learning
